name: typed-literal-margin-fit-128-v1
hypothesis: Some tested literal errors lie among low-margin bit alternatives; a finite model-ranked public-example repair can improve tested correctness without target-derived substitutions.
scope: 10 consumed fit requests only; no audit/protected/nearby-variant claim
preflight: Verify all pinned assets, exact codec descriptor and real sandbox; freeze code/config/dependencies before inference.

Recover missing literal logits with the existing frozen checkpoint, original query/memory representations and original encoder behavior. Preserve the historical1024-token truncation explicitly for this matched diagnostic; do not use it to authorize training.
Require all raw codes including bits to match the old10 fit captures exactly before trying any alternative. Mismatch stops and preserves failure; never silently substitute predictions.
arms: control: existing interior-empty correction and single public verification
candidate: same plus the literal-only search below after a valid graph fails public verification

construction.trigger: Structurally valid graph fails public examples; existing accepted answers unchanged
construction.permitted_edits: Only bits in already-active int/bool literal slots; keep op, first, next, bindings and types frozen after structural repair
construction.pool: Eight eligible bits with smallest absolute captured logit; deterministic slot/bit tie-break; Boolean slots only sign/magnitude combinations that decode as0 or1
construction.candidates: Single and two-bit flips ordered by summed absolute logit penalty, then lexicographic bit positions; strict codec validation before any execution
construction.stop: First public-passing candidate; otherwise abstain. Stop on budget or infrastructure failure. Independent tests never drive repair.

evidence: Preserve raw all-head logits, predictions and every candidate/edit/validation/public verdict.
Share one measured inference between arms; record complete route costs and each additional execution cost. Setup reported separately.
Seal all public decisions before loading original hash-bound fit source suites. Report wrong acceptances, useful/harmful corrections and costs.

acceptance.promotion: Fit development signal only; neither2a/2b qualification nor protected access. Reject the configuration if any criterion fails; no retry/tuning on these scored outcomes.

limitations: Public-example repair may overfit; passing original source tests is finite development evidence.
Two flips cannot repair the observed three/seven-bit cases in one candidate; preserve those failures.
This does not test or prove that balanced literal-head training would work. Any training proposal needs separate exact owner authorization and full-text input qualification.
